tasks.short: Interpret the music for the audience.

steps.what: Show the score used when applying knowledge of the piece.
Interpret or modify the music, using harmony, melody, rhythm, and voice production.
Individualize presentations to maintain audience interest.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the score already held. The musician interprets or modifies the music, applying knowledge of harmony, melody, rhythm, and voice production. The musician individualizes the presentation to keep the audience's interest. The score does not interpret the piece. A piece with no score leaves the screen blank, and the musician still interprets from memory.
tasks.previous_blocker: The score was the only guide, and a change for the audience was made in the moment and not remembered.
tasks.enabler_now: The score can be shown. The interpretation, and the change for the audience, stay with the musician.
tasks.still_hard: What will hold this audience is heard in the room, not written in the score.
tasks.human_edge: The musician interprets the music and adjusts the presentation. The score is the notation, not the reading of it.
tasks.altitude: Interpretation stays with the musician in front of the audience. The score is visible and is not an interpretation.

reach.task: Shape a line so the house stays with the scene.
reach.learn: The script is not the reading.

evidence.claim: A score already held is notation. It does not interpret harmony, melody, rhythm, or voice production.
Individualizing a presentation for an audience is the musician's judgement in the room. The score cannot hear the audience.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.
Fields: The piece id and the score only if it is already held. No interpretation is generated. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the score from the document store.
unknowns: Whether interpretation choices are written down after the concert or left in the playing.
research_questions: Who may change an interpretation that a conductor has already set?

already_counted.description: Interpreting the music and adjusting the presentation stay with the musician.

incremental.description: Replace the score when the edition changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still interprets and modifies the music and still adjusts the presentation for the audience. Only showing a score already held is removed. No interpretation is generated, and a piece with no score saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the singing exercise already set for this lesson.
Practice singing exercises and study with vocal coaches to develop the voice.
Rehearse the upcoming role the coach has just assigned.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the singing exercise if the coach has already set it. The musician practises the exercise and studies with the vocal coach to develop the voice and the skill, then rehearses the upcoming role the coach assigns in the lesson. The list does not sing. A lesson with no exercise leaves the screen blank. The note of the lesson is not a score of the musician.
tasks.previous_blocker: The exercise was named at the start of the lesson, and the upcoming role was a separate mail.
tasks.enabler_now: An exercise already set can be shown. The study with the coach stays in the room.
tasks.still_hard: Developing the voice takes the lesson, the coach's ear, and the musician's singing.
tasks.human_edge: The musician studies and sings. The exercise list is not the lesson.
tasks.altitude: The lesson stays with the musician and the coach. An exercise already set is shown, and nothing about the musician is scored.

reach.task: Run a skill session in the room.
reach.learn: A drill list is not the session.

evidence.claim: An exercise already set by the coach can be shown. It does not practise the singing or develop the voice.
The lesson is not a score of the musician. It is the singing and the role the coach assigned in the room.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.

Fields: The lesson id and the exercise only if the coach has already set it. The role is assigned by the coach, not by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the exercise from the document store.
Nothing in this task ranks or scores the musician.
unknowns: Whether the vocal coach is an employee or an outside teacher.
research_questions: Who assigns the upcoming role, the coach or the company?

already_counted.description: Studying with the coach and rehearsing the role stay with the musician.

incremental.description: Retire exercises the coach no longer uses.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still studies with the vocal coach and still rehearses the role assigned in the lesson. Only showing an exercise already set is removed. A lesson with no exercise saves nothing, and the musician is not scored.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show whether this piece is marked a cappella or with accompaniment.
Sing a cappella or with musical accompaniment.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the mark already on the piece, a cappella or with musical accompaniment. The musician sings it that way. The mark does not sing, and it does not generate an accompaniment. A piece with no mark leaves the screen blank, and the musician follows what the room is doing.
tasks.previous_blocker: The accompaniment mark was a pencil note, and a singer started unaccompanied against a piano.
tasks.enabler_now: A mark already on the piece can be shown. The singing stays with the musician.
tasks.still_hard: Singing with or without accompaniment is the performance, not the mark on the page.
tasks.human_edge: The musician sings. The mark only repeats what the piece already says.
tasks.altitude: The singing stays with the musician, a cappella or accompanied. No accompaniment is generated.

reach.task: Play a scene with or without underscoring.
reach.learn: The mark on the script is not the scene.

evidence.claim: A mark already on the piece says a cappella or accompanied. It does not sing, and it does not play the accompaniment.
Generating an accompaniment is not this task. The musician sings with the players who are there, or alone.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.

Fields: The piece id and the accompaniment mark only if it is already on the piece. The mark is not inferred, and no accompaniment is generated. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the piece from the document store.
unknowns: Whether the accompanist is booked separately from this musician.
research_questions: Who sets the a cappella mark, the editor of the score or the conductor?

already_counted.description: Singing the piece stays with the musician.

incremental.description: Correct the mark when a new edition changes it.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still sings a cappella or with accompaniment. Only showing a mark already on the piece is removed. No accompaniment is generated, and a piece with no mark saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the piece already chosen for this lesson on a specific instrument.
Note the passage that was taught, not a grade of the pupil.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the piece already chosen for the lesson and the instrument it is for. The musician teaches that music in the room. The note lists the passage that was taught. It does not grade the pupil. The piece list does not teach. A lesson with no chosen piece leaves the screen blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The piece was agreed by mouth, and the passage taught was forgotten by the next lesson.
tasks.enabler_now: A chosen piece can be shown. Teaching it stays in the room with the pupil.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing a pupil's hand on a specific instrument takes the teacher in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The musician teaches. The note records the passage, not a score of the pupil.
tasks.altitude: Teaching stays in the room. The note names the passage that was taught and does not grade the pupil.

reach.task: Teach a skill and record the drill, not a rating of the person.
reach.learn: The drill list is not the lesson.

evidence.claim: Showing a piece already chosen for a lesson is a lookup. It does not teach the instrument.
The note names the passage taught. It is not a grade of the pupil and is not used to rank pupils.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.

Fields: The lesson id, the instrument, and the piece only if already chosen. The piece is not selected by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the piece from the document store.
The note does not grade or rank the pupil.
unknowns: Whether pupils are children, which changes who may see the note.
research_questions: Who chooses the piece before the lesson, the musician or the pupil?

already_counted.description: Teaching and noting the passage stay with the musician.

incremental.description: Close lesson notes for pupils who have left.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still teaches the instrument in the room. Only showing a piece already chosen is removed. The note names the passage taught and does not grade the pupil. A lesson with no piece saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The musician still interprets the music, still studies with the vocal coach, still sings, and still teaches. A score or an exercise list does not do that work.
reach: Art directors shape a piece for an audience, and this job learns the interpretation stays with the musician.
Coaches and scouts teach a skill in the room, and this job learns a piece list is not the lesson.
skills_to_grow: Interpret the music for the audience rather than follow the score as a script.
Study with the vocal coach in the lesson.
Teach the instrument in the room, and note the passage, not a grade.
role.ambitious_version: Interpretation, vocal study, singing, and teaching stay with the musician. Stored scores and exercise lists only open what is already written.
